prompt: Implement ticket 02 of the s1-auto-router spec. The repository is a Claude Code plugin that routes the Model and Effort of every Agent spawn using a local System One model. Read the ticket, the spec and the ADR, then build the Python runtime that loads the Decider checkpoint and returns per-option probabilities for choice, yes/no and score questions. Check first whether decider-ai loads the MLX DWQ checkpoint; if it does not, implement the plain mlx-lm path with the trained Context / Question / Options / Answer layout and a softmax over the option-letter logits at the per-type temperatures from decider_config.json. Measure cold load, per-request latency for the six default questions on a 4k character prompt, independent and packed, and the peak RAM. Record the numbers in the ticket under Answer.
